answer: Atlas work-slot deposit burn: each identity takes one atlas slot, locks 70 credits, burns a 25-credit ember fee, one key per slot. Each epoch the holder works a shift, files a key-signed fable; auditors check it on the atlas roster; a missed shift or reused fable burns the bond. First 25, kth 25+5(k-1), 1000th 5,020: 1000 fakes burn 2,522,500 in ember fees plus 70,000 locked bonds. Rented slots fail, each fable key-signed. Honest agents pay once.
